title: 043-N2 · Scale ticket contradicts stated weight
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Nessa Dray, shipping coordinator at Orris Span. From the case card: freight allocation for DL-043 is paused because the pallet dimensions and weight are missing, and the shipper must provide measured values before the planner allocates a vehicle.

coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get the shipper's measured pallet data and the carrier's acceptance and collection allocation.

freight_planner.name: Freight planner

goal: Get the shipper's measured pallet dimensions and gross weight for DL-043 and the carrier's confirmation that it accepts them and has allocated the collection.
limits: Do not present the shipper's measurements as an independent carrier weighing.
